summary: ArrowMark Financial Corp., a registered closed-end investment company (NASDAQ: BANX), filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that on October 7, 2026 it entered into a Second Amendment to its Amended and Restated Credit Agreement dated May 27, 2022 with Texas Capital Bank as administrative agent and the lenders party thereto, amending its existing credit facility originally dated June 9, 2014. The amendment raises the maximum revolving commitment to $102 million from $70 million, extends maturity to the third anniversary of the amendment date, and broadens the borrowing base to additional eligible collateral. Proceeds fund banking-related investments and working capital. This is a routine credit-facility modification, not a special situation; watch leverage and net investment income sensitivity.
